description: List of planned refactors to improve code quality, type safety, security, and robustness.

features.name: Environment-based Backend Configuration
features.description: Current backend URL is hardcoded to localhost:5167 in claudeService.ts and api.rs. Should be moved to environment variables for staging/production builds.
steps: Create or update .env files with VITE_BACKEND_URL or NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL
Update BACKEND export in claudeService.ts to use the environment variable with a fallback to localhost
Update APP_SERVER_URL in api/api.rs:21 to read from Tauri config or env

features.name: Discriminated Unions for Events
features.description: ClaudeFrontendEvent currently has all payload fields set as nullable (string | null). Refactoring to a Discriminated Union based on event_type will improve TypeScript autocompletion and prevent null errors when accessing fields.
steps: Define BaseEvent with common fields like meeting_id and session_id
Define strict payload types for text_delta, tool_call, tool_result, error, and done events
Combine into a union type for ClaudeFrontendEvent
Update components using the event to leverage the new type narrowing

features.name: Robust SSE Stream Parsing
features.description: Manual string splitting on '\n' for SSE events in streamClaudeSession can break if chunks are split unexpectedly. Standardizing SSE parsing will prevent stream hangs.
steps: Consider integrating a standard SSE parser library (e.g., @microsoft/fetch-event-source)
Alternatively, improve the manual buffer reading to correctly accumulate and parse '\n\n' separated events
Ensure reader.releaseLock() is guaranteed in a finally block to prevent resource leaks on errors
Add fetch timeout via AbortSignal (claudeService.ts:47-52 has no timeout)

features.name: Explicit REST Error Handling
features.description: REST helpers like clearClaudeSession and cancelClaudeSession swallow HTTP errors silently. getClaudeSession returns null on 500 errors, hiding crashes.
steps: Check res.ok in clearClaudeSession and cancelClaudeSession, and throw an Error with status text if false
Update getClaudeSession to only return null on a 404 status, and throw for 500s or other errors
Ensure calling UI components wrap these calls in try/catch to show toast notifications on failure

features.name: Promise-Wrapped Streaming
features.description: streamClaudeSession uses an async IIFE, meaning the caller receives the AbortController but has no Promise to await when the stream finishes.
steps: Wrap the IIFE logic inside streamClaudeSession into a Promise
Return an object containing both the abort function (from the controller) and the Promise
Update callers in ClaudeContext to optionally await the stream completion for cleaner async flow

features.name: Fix SQL Injection in Settings Queries
features.description: Both Rust (setting.rs) and Python (db.py) build SQL queries via string formatting with column names from provider input. While provider validation exists, the column names themselves are interpolated unsafely. Investigation confirmed validation was already safe; consolidated 5 duplicated Python validation blocks into shared dict-based lookups.
steps: In setting.rs:96 and :134, replace format!() SQL with a strict column-name enum/map that returns only whitelisted strings
In db.py:607, :611, :641, :728, :732, :765, replace f-string SQL with a dict lookup mapping provider to column name
Add unit tests confirming that invalid provider names are rejected before SQL construction
Audit all other dynamic SQL in both db.py and setting.rs

features.name: Sanitize User Input in Claude Agent
features.description: claude_agent.py has path traversal risk (project_dir passed to os.path.join without validation) and prompt injection risk (meeting_title interpolated into system prompt unsanitized).
steps: Validate project_dir is absolute and does not contain '..' (claude_agent.py:148)
Sanitize or escape meeting_title before interpolating into system prompt (claude_agent.py:316-322)
Add allowlist of permitted base directories for project_dir
Sanitize error messages to prevent API key leakage (claude_agent.py:484-486)

features.name: Split Backend main.py into Route Modules
features.description: main.py is 1,052 lines containing 15+ Pydantic models, SummaryProcessor class, 20+ endpoint definitions across 5 domains (meetings, summary, config, AI, anonymization), NotificationBus class, and process_transcript_background (247+ lines). Should be decomposed into focused modules.
steps: Extract Pydantic models to models.py
Extract meeting CRUD endpoints to endpoints/meetings.py
Extract summary processing to endpoints/summary.py
Extract config/settings endpoints to endpoints/config.py
Extract Claude agent endpoints to endpoints/ai.py
Extract anonymization endpoints to endpoints/anonymize.py
Extract SummaryProcessor class to processor.py
Extract background task logic to background_tasks.py
Wire up FastAPI APIRouter in main.py importing all route modules

features.name: Split ClaudeContext into Focused Contexts
features.description: ClaudeContext.tsx is 621 lines handling streaming, anonymization, basket management, conversation history, API key persistence, and entity mapping. Should be 3 focused contexts.
steps: Extract basket management into ContextBasketContext (add/remove/clear/toggle items)
Extract anonymization logic into AnonymizationContext (toggle, entity map, anonymize call)
Keep ClaudeSessionContext for streaming, conversation, and session lifecycle
Update layout.tsx provider tree and all consuming components
Extract duplicated RAF batching into a useRAFBatch() utility hook

features.name: Flatten Provider Pyramid of Doom
features.description: layout.tsx has 13+ nested context providers. Makes testing impossible and creates deep component trees. Should use a provider composition pattern.
steps: Create a ComposeProviders utility component that accepts an array of [Provider, props] tuples, or group contexts by domain (e.g., AppProviders vs MeetingProviders)
Replace nested JSX providers in layout.tsx with flat ComposeProviders call
Add React Error Boundaries wrapping major sections (sidebar, main content, AI panel)

features.name: Replace Rust .lock().unwrap() with Error Handling
features.description: 120 .lock().unwrap() calls remain across 7 active files. Investigation showed pattern is safe (short scopes, no cross-await). Fixed recording_commands.rs (20 occurrences on hot path), replaced panic!() in pipeline.rs with Result, fixed tray.rs caller. Remaining breakdown: recording_state.rs (42), analytics/commands.rs (25), parakeet_engine/commands.rs (16), whisper_engine/commands.rs (15), buffer_pool.rs (4), core_audio.rs (2).
steps: Sweep recording_state.rs: replace 42 .lock().unwrap() with .lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) or parking_lot::Mutex
Sweep analytics/commands.rs: replace 25 .lock().unwrap()
Sweep parakeet_engine/commands.rs: replace 16 .lock().unwrap()
Sweep whisper_engine/commands.rs: replace 15 .lock().unwrap()
Sweep buffer_pool.rs and core_audio.rs: replace remaining 6 .lock().unwrap()
Delete recording_commands.rs.backup (16 dead .lock().unwrap() calls, stale backup file)

features.name: Add TTL/Cleanup to In-Memory Registries
features.description: Anonymizer entity registries (_registries dict) and Claude session dict grow unbounded. After many meetings, memory usage increases indefinitely.
steps: Add TTL-based cleanup to anonymizer._registries (anonymizer.py:414) — evict after 2hrs of inactivity
Add periodic background cleanup task for claude_agent._sessions (currently only cleaned on request)
Add max-size cap to both registries with LRU eviction
Fix Faker seeding race condition (anonymizer.py:211-212) — use per-instance Faker, not global seed

features.name: Fix Sync/Async Mixing in db.py
features.description: db.py:364-388 uses sync sqlite3.connect() for save_meeting() while everything else uses async aiosqlite. This blocks the event loop under load.
steps: Convert save_meeting() (db.py:364-388) to use async aiosqlite
Convert save_meeting_transcript() (db.py:394-410) to use async aiosqlite
Add connection pooling or reuse pattern instead of creating new connection per call (db.py:162-168)
Audit all remaining sync sqlite3 usage and convert to aiosqlite

features.name: Add Rate Limiting and Input Validation
features.description: No rate limiting on any endpoint. Search queries and JSON payloads have no size limits. Any client can spam /process-transcript to exhaust server resources.
steps: Add slowapi or similar rate limiter to FastAPI (main.py)
Add max query length to /search-transcripts endpoint (main.py:651)
Add max payload size middleware for JSON request bodies
Validate meeting_id format on all endpoints accepting it
Add backpressure or queue for /process-transcript background tasks

features.name: Add React Error Boundaries
features.description: No error boundaries anywhere in the React tree. A crash in any component (e.g., transcript rendering, AI panel) takes down the entire app.
steps: Create ErrorBoundary component with fallback UI and retry button
Wrap Sidebar, main content area, and AI panel each in their own ErrorBoundary
Add error logging to ErrorBoundary (optional: send to backend for diagnostics)
Test by throwing in each major section to verify isolation

features.name: Eliminate Dual State Tracking in Frontend
features.description: page.tsx mirrors context state in local state (line 31-41). ClaudeContext uses both stateRef and state (line 175-176). RecordingStateContext has missing useCallback dependencies (line 81). These cause stale closures and subtle bugs.
steps: Remove local isRecording state from page.tsx — use recordingState.isRecording directly
Consolidate stateRef/state pattern in ClaudeContext into a single useReducer
Fix missing dependencies in RecordingStateContext useCallback (line 81)
Audit all contexts for stale closure risks using eslint-plugin-react-hooks exhaustive-deps

features.name: Split Monolithic Rust Files
features.description: api/api.rs (1,651 lines), recording_commands.rs (1,300 lines), whisper_engine.rs (1,182 lines), pipeline.rs (1,145 lines), and parakeet_engine.rs (1,089 lines) are all god files mixing multiple concerns. Additionally model_manager.rs (851 lines) is approaching the threshold.
steps: Split api/api.rs into api/meetings.rs, api/settings.rs, api/transcripts.rs, api/models.rs
Split recording_commands.rs into recording_lifecycle.rs (start/stop/pause) and recording_config.rs (devices/preferences)
Split whisper_engine.rs into model_manager.rs (download/load) and transcriber.rs (inference)
Apply same split to parakeet_engine.rs
Extract resampling logic from pipeline.rs into audio/resampler.rs
Remove lib_old_complex.rs (2437 lines of dead legacy code)

features.name: Fix Resource Leaks in Audio and Drag-Drop
features.description: Module-level mutable state in useDragAndDrop.ts (line 13-14), missing Drop impls for Rust audio streams, orphaned senders in recording_saver.rs, and global window.triggerHandoff assignment without cleanup.
steps: Replace module-level _internalDragActive and _dragListeners in useDragAndDrop.ts with React context or ref
Add Drop impl for StreamBackend (stream.rs:17-29) to properly stop/await audio tasks
Fix recording_saver.rs orphaned receiver when start_accumulation() called multiple times
Clean up window.triggerHandoff on unmount in useHandoffExport.ts
Replace deprecated 'let mounted = true' pattern in ScreenshotContext with AbortController

features.name: Unify or Bridge the Two SQLite Databases
features.description: Rust frontend (sqlx) and Python backend (aiosqlite) each maintain separate SQLite databases. No sync mechanism exists. Meetings can be orphaned if either side fails. Settings duplicated in both with hardcoded id='1'.
steps: Audit which data actually needs to be in both DBs vs. only one
Option A: Make backend read from the Rust SQLite (single source of truth for meetings/transcripts)
Option B: Add an event-driven sync layer (Rust emits events when meetings change, backend listens)
Option C: Consolidate into a single shared SQLite with separate connection pools
Remove hardcoded id='1' in settings — use named keys or single-row pattern properly

features.name: Consistent Backend Error Handling
features.description: Backend endpoints expose raw exception strings to clients (main.py:187,211,224,373), have inconsistent response structures, log PII-containing data on parse errors, and swallow exceptions in background tasks.
steps: Create a standard error response model with error codes (not raw str(e))
Add exception handler middleware to FastAPI that sanitizes error messages
Fix background task error swallowing in process_transcript_background (main.py:319-334)
Redact potentially PII-containing data from log messages (main.py:302,304)
Ensure shutdown_event cleans up all resources (Claude sessions, DB connections, Presidio)

features.name: Fix Frontend Performance Anti-Patterns
features.description: New reqwest::Client created per API call (api.rs:248), no memoization on 27 destructured context values in ClaudePanel, duplicate useMemo chains in VirtualizedTranscriptView, and RecordingStateContext polls at fixed 500ms with no backoff.
steps: Create a static/cached reqwest::Client in api.rs instead of new per call
Add React.memo to ClaudePanel child components to prevent unnecessary re-renders
Combine duplicate useMemo chains in VirtualizedTranscriptView (lines 65-77)
Add exponential backoff to RecordingStateContext polling (currently fixed 500ms)
Extract formatRecordingTime into shared utils (duplicated in 3+ files)
Remove dead code: cleanStopWords in VirtualizedTranscriptView, dead playback vars in RecordingControls

features.name: Fix Rust Thread Safety and Atomic Inconsistencies
features.description: recording_commands.rs mixes AtomicBool with Mutex<Option<T>> without synchronized access. IS_RECORDING can be checked without holding the RECORDING_MANAGER lock, creating race conditions.
steps: Consolidate IS_RECORDING + RECORDING_MANAGER into a single Mutex<RecordingState> struct
Replace 11 separate Mutex fields in recording_state.rs with a single RwLock<RecordingStateInner>
Add proper error callback handling — current Mutex<Box<dyn Fn>> can panic during Drop
Audit unsafe impl Send for StreamBackend (stream.rs:29,38) — document why it's safe or fix

features.name: Remove Unused Rich Text Editors
features.description: package.json currently imports `@remirror/*` and `@tiptap/*` libraries, but a full codebase search reveals they are completely unused (Tandem is strictly using `@blocknote` in Editor.tsx / BlockNoteSummaryView.tsx).
steps: Remove `@remirror/*` and `@tiptap/*` dependencies from frontend package.json
Run `pnpm install` or `npm install` to update lockfile
Verify build succeeds without these heavy dependencies

features.name: Implement CI/CD Pipeline (GitHub Actions)
features.description: There is an empty `.github/workflows` folder, meaning PRs rely wholly on manual testing. CI checks are critical for ensuring regressions are not merged.
steps: Add `.github/workflows/ci.yml` for automated testing
Configure Node steps: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm build`, `vitest`
Configure Rust steps: `cargo check`, `cargo clippy`, `cargo fmt --check`
Configure Python steps: `pytest`, `ruff check .`

features.name: Replace Flat requirements.txt with pyproject.toml
features.description: backend/requirements.txt is a flat list mixing app and dev dependencies without lockfile pinning. Moving to uv or poetry will stabilize builds and environments.
steps: Initialize `pyproject.toml` using `uv` or `poetry` in the backend directory
Migrate production dependencies (FastAPI, aiosqlite, pydantic) to main deps block
Migrate development dependencies (pytest) to dev block
Generate a lockfile and update documentation/scripts

features.name: Consolidate Backend Docker/Shell Scripts
features.description: The backend folder contains multiple Dockerfile variants and 10+ ad-hoc shell scripts. These should be unified into a Makefile or robust docker-compose structure to improve Developer Experience.
steps: Delete redundant shell scripts in favor of a single Makefile or Justfile
Consolidate `Dockerfile.server-*` into a single multi-stage Dockerfile or standardized docker-compose.yml overrides

features.name: Replace Debug print() with Logger in TranscriptProcessor
features.description: transcript_processor.py has 3 bare print() statements in chat_ollama_model() that bypass the logging framework, pollute stdout, and leak internal state in production.
steps: Replace print(content, end='', flush=True) at line 268 with logger.debug()
Replace print(summary.model_dump_json()) at line 273 with logger.debug()
Replace print(f'Error parsing response: {e}') at line 276 with logger.error()
Verify no other bare print() calls exist in backend/app/

features.name: Replace Deprecated datetime.utcnow() Calls
features.description: db.py uses datetime.utcnow() in 7 places. This is deprecated in Python 3.12+ and scheduled for removal. Should use datetime.now(timezone.utc) instead.
steps: Add 'from datetime import timezone' to db.py imports
Replace all datetime.utcnow() with datetime.now(timezone.utc) (lines 172, 215, 296, 331, 456, 854, 882)
Search for utcnow() in other backend files and fix

features.name: Replace Deprecated @app.on_event with Lifespan Context Manager
features.description: main.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') decorator (line 843). FastAPI 0.93+ recommends the lifespan async context manager pattern instead.
steps: Create an async lifespan context manager with startup/shutdown logic
Move shutdown_event() cleanup into lifespan's teardown
Pass lifespan= to FastAPI() constructor
Remove @app.on_event decorator

features.name: Fix Unclosed Ollama AsyncClient Sessions
features.description: transcript_processor.py creates AsyncClient instances (line 259) tracked in self.active_clients, but the finally block only removes from the list without calling .aclose(). The cleanup() method uses fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task() that may not complete before shutdown.
steps: Add await client._client.aclose() in the finally block of chat_ollama_model()
In cleanup(), await asyncio.gather() instead of fire-and-forget create_task()
Add timeout to cleanup gather to prevent hanging on shutdown

features.name: Remove Dead Playback Variables from RecordingControls
features.description: RecordingControls.tsx has 4 dead variables (currentTime, duration, isPlaying, progress) at lines 62-65 from an abandoned playback feature. These confuse readers and suggest incomplete functionality.
steps: Remove unused const currentTime, duration, isPlaying, progress from RecordingControls.tsx
Remove any related JSX that references these variables
Check for similar dead code in sibling components

features.name: Guard or Remove Console.log Statements in Frontend
features.description: logger.ts was created and the 4 originally-listed files (Sidebar, TranscriptView, RecordingControls, layout.tsx) were migrated. However, 300+ console.log/warn/error calls remain across 30+ other frontend files. Biggest offenders: analytics.ts (69), TranscriptContext.tsx (38), useSummaryGeneration.ts (30), BlockNoteSummaryView.tsx (23), useCopyOperations.ts (17), RecordingStateContext.tsx (14), indexedDBService.ts (14), useMeetingData.ts (11), ScreenshotContext.tsx (10), ClaudePanel.tsx (7), useVoiceCommand.ts (6), BlockNoteEditor/Editor.tsx (5).
steps: DONE: Create a lightweight logger utility (src/lib/logger.ts) that respects NODE_ENV
DONE: Replace console.log calls in Sidebar/index.tsx, TranscriptView.tsx, RecordingControls.tsx, layout.tsx
Migrate analytics.ts (69 calls) — mostly console.error/warn, keep only genuine errors
Migrate TranscriptContext.tsx (38 calls) to logger
Migrate useSummaryGeneration.ts (30 calls) to logger
Migrate BlockNoteSummaryView.tsx (23 calls) to logger
Migrate remaining 25+ files with console calls to logger
Keep console.error only for genuine unrecoverable errors at module boundaries

features.name: Add Drop Impl for RecordingSaver
features.description: RecordingSaver holds Arc-wrapped resources (incremental_saver, transcript_segments, chunk_receiver) and spawned tokio tasks but has no Drop implementation. When dropped, background tasks continue running and channels remain open.
steps: Implement Drop for RecordingSaver that closes the chunk receiver
Signal any running accumulation task to stop via a cancellation token
Log cleanup actions for debugging
Test by starting/stopping recordings rapidly

features.name: Add Panic Recovery to Spawned Audio Tasks
features.description: Core Audio processing tasks spawned via tokio::spawn in stream.rs have no panic recovery. If a task panics, audio capture silently stops without notifying the recording system or the user.
steps: Wrap spawned audio task closures in catch_unwind or use JoinHandle monitoring
On task panic/failure, emit a Tauri event to notify the frontend
Add a watchdog that detects stalled audio tasks (no data for N seconds)
Log panic details for post-mortem debugging

features.name: Remove Dead Code and #[allow(dead_code)] in Rust
features.description: lib_old_complex.rs (2,437 lines) was deleted. However, core-old.rs (923 lines) and recording_saver_old.rs (dead code with 7 unsafe blocks) still exist and are unreferenced from any mod.rs. recording_commands.rs.backup (stale backup) also present. Additionally, 19 #[allow(dead_code)] annotations remain across the codebase (anthropic.rs, api.rs, batch_processor.rs, ffmpeg_mixer.rs, notifications/system.rs).
steps: DONE: Delete lib_old_complex.rs (2,437 lines of dead legacy code)
DONE: Remove or feature-gate dead Timestamp/TimestampedChunk code in ffmpeg_mixer.rs
Delete frontend/src-tauri/src/audio/core-old.rs (923 lines, unreferenced dead code)
Delete frontend/src-tauri/src/audio/recording_saver_old.rs (dead code, 7 unsafe blocks)
Delete frontend/src-tauri/src/audio/recording_commands.rs.backup (stale backup file)
Audit remaining 19 #[allow(dead_code)] annotations — remove dead code or justify annotation
Run cargo check to verify nothing breaks

features.name: Extract Hardcoded Constants from Frontend Components
features.description: Magic numbers scattered across components: token estimate divisor (4), max textarea height (120px), context basket max-height (200px), min recording duration (2000ms), chunk sizes for Ollama models. Should be centralized.
steps: Create frontend/src/lib/constants.ts with UI/timing/algorithm constants
Extract CHAR_TO_TOKEN_RATIO from ContextBasket.tsx
Extract TEXTAREA_MAX_HEIGHT from ClaudePanel.tsx
Extract MIN_RECORDING_DURATION_MS from RecordingControls.tsx
Extract OLLAMA_CHUNK_SIZE constants from transcript_processor.py to a config section

features.name: Remove `as any` Type Casts in Frontend
features.description: 54 `as any` casts across frontend TypeScript code. Each bypasses type safety and masks potential runtime errors. Many are workarounds for incomplete type definitions that should be fixed at the source (proper interfaces, generics, or type narrowing).
steps: Audit all 54 `as any` casts — categorize as: (a) fixable with proper types, (b) necessary for FFI/Tauri invoke, (c) workaround for library types
Fix category (a) by adding proper interfaces or using type narrowing
For category (b), replace with `as unknown as TargetType` or typed invoke wrappers
For category (c), add // eslint-disable-next-line with justification comment
Run pnpm tsc --noEmit to verify no regressions

features.name: Standardize Tauri Event Listener Cleanup Pattern
features.description: Multiple contexts (RecordingStateContext, ConfigContext, ClipboardContext, OnboardingContext, layout.tsx) have async listener setup races — the same root bug in 5 places. The pattern: setup() is async but useEffect cleanup runs before listeners resolve, leaking event listeners. Bugs B010, B012, B015, B031, B033 all describe variants of this. A single useTauriListener hook would fix all 5 simultaneously.
steps: Create frontend/src/hooks/useTauriListener.ts — wraps Tauri listen() with abort flag and cleanup guarantees
Pattern: useEffect sets up AbortController, passes signal to async setup, cleanup calls controller.abort() and stores unlisten fns in ref
Migrate RecordingStateContext.tsx (B012: async listener setup race)
Migrate ConfigContext.tsx (B015: cleanup variable undefined on unmount)
Migrate ClipboardContext.tsx (B033: async listener race, mounted flag missing)
Migrate OnboardingContext.tsx (B031: async setup race, setState on unmounted component)
Migrate layout.tsx (B010: .then(fn => fn()) cleanup race condition)
This single hook fix resolves 5 open bugs (B010, B012, B015, B031, B033) simultaneously

features.name: Replace Bare except Exception with Specific Types
features.description: 69 bare `except Exception as e:` blocks across backend Python files. These catch everything including KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit, mask the root cause of failures, and leak internal state via str(e) in HTTP responses (main.py:208, 222, 232, 245, 575, 625, 633, 640). Should use specific exception types with appropriate HTTP status codes.
steps: Audit all 69 except Exception blocks — categorize by actual exception types thrown
In main.py endpoints: separate ValueError (400) from sqlite3/aiosqlite errors (500) from network errors (502/503)
In db.py: catch aiosqlite.Error specifically, not all exceptions
In claude_agent.py: catch anthropic API errors separately from file I/O errors
Never expose str(e) in HTTP response detail — use sanitized user-facing error messages
Keep bare except Exception only at outermost handler (lifespan, background tasks) with logging
